name: Gastonia
sum: Gastonia is a heavily armoured polacanthid ankylosaur from the Lower Cretaceous Cedar Mountain Formation of Utah, known from many individuals.
wsnote: 4.6 m in the Natural History Museum (London) Dino Directory; 6 m was Kirkland's 1998 estimate as reported by a secondary source.
holotype: CEUM 1307, an adult skull about 295 mm long and 283 mm wide — Yellow Cat Quarry, Yellow Cat Member, Cedar Mountain Formation, Grand County, Utah.
material: Hundreds of disarticulated bones and several partial skeletons from Gaston and Dalton Wells quarries; G. lorriemcwhinneyae comes from a bonebed in a higher member (Ruby Ranch Member).
biology: Sacral shield with paired keeled "quarter rings" and large shoulder spikes; bonebeds of several individuals may reflect group death by drought or drowning (G. lorriemcwhinneyae).
author: Kirkland 1998
